text: Please accept this letter as my request to add a new item of business to the June 2018, Scarborough Community Council agenda which asks Economic Development staff and Transportation staff to report on the feasibility of installing Traffic Control Signals on Progress Avenue at the Entrance for Toyota Canada Inc. (830 Progress Avenue) and Bell (831 Progress Avenue) and extending the existing sidewalk to the entrance of Toyota Canada Inc. head office.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested Economic Development staff and Transportation Services staff to report to the July 4, 2018 meeting on the feasibility of installing Traffic Control Signals on Progress Avenue at the Entrance for Toyota Canada Inc. (830 Progress Avenue) and Bell (831 Progress Avenue) and extending the existing sidewalk to the entrance of Toyota Canada Inc. head office.
